headline: PSEi inches up, but economic concerns linger
summary: The Philippine Stock Exchange index rose 0.2 percent, or 10.96 points, to close at 5,511.84, while the broader All Shares index dipped 0.1 percent. Economic headwinds kept the recovery fragile.
why: The PSEi is the benchmark index of the Philippine Stock Exchange, tracking the largest listed companies in the country.
